style: Premium SaaS product shot of the REAL Aurali app, sidebar and all — no cropped-out chrome this time. The whole app window pops into frame with a subtle 3D tilt, then the camera auto-scrolls down the real 'Analíticas' page (two consecutive scroll captures stitched into one continuous page), then the app switches tabs on its own to 'Procesos legales', with the sidebar's active-item highlight sliding to match — exactly like a real user's screen, but unattended. No cursor, no click, no narration. Calm, confident, high-end fintech/legal-tech energy (Linear/Stripe product shots).

customize.asset_status: RESOLVED — no sourcing needed. All 3 PNGs in assets/ were overwritten by the user with generic placeholder data (Camila Rojas, Andrés Gómez, Valentina Cruz, Santiago Londoño, @ejemplo.com) and contain zero blur. Treat pixel content as final and legible; no redaction/blur treatment should be applied by the Builder.
customize.scene_reinterpretation: IMPORTANT CHANGE FROM PRIOR VERSION: dashboard-1.png and dashboard-2.png are NOT two different screens/scenes. They are the SAME 'Analíticas' page captured at two consecutive scroll positions (dashboard-2 continues exactly where dashboard-1's viewport ended). There are only 2 real screens in this video: 'Analíticas' (scrolled) and 'Procesos legales'. The prior cascading-cards concept is fully replaced by an autonomous continuous scroll + one tab switch.
customize.global_scale_factor: k = 0.3265 (= container_w 960 / source image width 2940). Every crop below is scaled by this same k so sidebar and content stay in correct real-world proportion to each other.

app_container.desc: The entire app window (sidebar + content, no browser chrome/URL bar) is one hand-authored container that is now the star of the entrance beat.
app_container.background: #FFFFFF panel, 1px border #E5E7EB, soft drop shadow (0 30px 80px rgba(30,27,75,0.18)), plus the existing brand glow behind it on the 1080x1080 canvas (#7C3AED ~6% opacity top-right radial, #1E1B4B ~4% opacity bottom-left radial) — background glow is static across the whole 9s, unaffected by the tilt.

entrance_3d.desc: Container-level pop-in: opacity 0→1 AND a diagonal 3D tilt that settles flat. Apply perspective on the canvas-level parent (not the container itself) so the tilt reads with real depth.
entrance_3d.note: rotateX tilts the top edge away/back, rotateY tilts toward one side — combined reads as 'tilted diagonally in space, unfolding flat'. Transform-origin: center. Do not fade the background glow or canvas — only the container tilts/fades.

sidebar.desc: Persistent left nav, ALWAYS visible for the full 9s (this is the #1 fix vs. the previous cut — the menu must never be cropped or hidden). Static base layer per active view (cropped directly from the source PNGs, which already contain the correct highlighted item baked in), with a hand-authored highlight-pill overlay used only during the tab-switch to animate the slide.

source_crop_view1.note: full-height sidebar column as it appears in the Analíticas page; 'Analíticas' row already shows the light-gray active background baked into the pixels.

source_crop_view2.note: same sidebar column from the Procesos legales page; 'Procesos legales' row shows the active background baked in. ~8px taller than view1's crop (1644 vs 1636) — negligible, scale to the same 534px container height.

nav_rows_scaled_px.note: row rectangles in CONTAINER-LOCAL coordinates (add x:60,y:273 for canvas-absolute), estimated from visual inspection of the source PNGs at k=0.3265 — Builder should confirm exact pixel bounds against the asset before finalizing the pill keyframes, these are close approximations.

profile_footer.note: 'Ana Martinez' card pinned to bottom, already generic in source

sidebar.highlight_slide_mechanism: During the tab transition (5.6s-6.0s) only: crossfade the two static sidebar crops (view1 → view2, opacity swap) WHILE an additional hand-authored highlight pill (rounded-rect, fill #F1F5F9, matching the baked highlight color) translateY's from the analiticas row (y:67,h:24) to procesos_legales row (y:94,h:24) directly under the crossfading labels, so the motion reads as one continuous slide rather than a hard swap. Pill moves for the full 0.4s window, ease power2.inOut; the underlying crop crossfade is timed to be ~70% opacity-transitioned by the time the pill arrives, so label text never looks doubled.

content_viewport.desc: Right-hand content pane, overflow:hidden, showing a translateY-scrolled real page for View 1 and a static frame for View 2.

view1_scroll_stack.desc: dashboard-1 and dashboard-2 stitched into one virtual tall page by direct vertical concatenation (they are literally consecutive scroll captures of the same route), cropped to content-only (sidebar excluded) at region_px [544, 0, 2396, <full height>] from each source, then scaled by k=0.3265.

splice_point.concatenation: source_b's y=0 is placed immediately at source_a's y=1636 (zero-gap, zero-overlap direct splice) — this is the exact px point where dashboard-2 continues dashboard-1's scroll.
splice_point.seam_softening: a ~40px-tall (original scale, ~13px scaled) crossfade blend centered on the seam (original y 1616-1656) to absorb the ~6px height mismatch between the two captures (1636 vs 1642) and any minor scroll-timing misalignment — NOT a hard pixel cut.

scroll_animation.desc: Viewport (h=534) starts perfectly bookended on the combined stack's top (showing all of dashboard-1's headline cards + start of the two charts) and ends perfectly bookended on the stack's bottom (showing all of dashboard-2's 6 stat tiles + Volumen mensual bar chart + Distribución por estado donut) — the -534 endpoint is exactly combined_stack_height(1070) - viewport_h(534) = 536, rounded to 534 for the bookend fit. No scrollbar, no cursor — content simply glides upward on its own, reinforcing autopilot.

pre_scroll_hold.desc: 0.45s static hold at the very top the instant the container finishes popping in, so the viewer registers 'Analíticas' + the 3 headline stat cards before motion starts.

post_scroll_hold.desc: 0.3s static hold at the very bottom (Volumen mensual + Distribución por estado fully visible) before the tab transition begins.

tab_transition.motion: crossfade content_viewport from the dashboard-2 bottom frame to the proceso-legal-1 top frame (opacity swap, no slide/scale on the content layer itself — the sidebar pill-slide described above carries the sense of motion). A very slight 2% scale punch (1.0→1.02→1.0) on the incoming content softens the cut.
tab_transition.sync: runs in lockstep with the sidebar highlight_slide_mechanism above (same 5.6-6.0s window).

view2_frame.note: content-only crop (sidebar excluded, it's handled by the sidebar layer). Scaled height 1644*k=536.8, ~matches the 534 viewport height almost exactly (0.5% overflow) — no scroll needed for view 2, it's a single static frame with the 4 cards revealed via cascade below.

hold.motion: static, no new motion — lets the completed panel breathe before loop point

reused_polish_blocks.use: very subtle, constant, keeps focus on the app container over the brand background
low intensity (~4-6%) for a premium, non-flat finish

customize.explicitly_avoided: cursor-move / click-ripple primitives from the webpage module — a visible cursor or scrollbar would read as manual intervention, contradicting the 'piloto automático' message. Scroll and tab-switch are both fully autonomous (opacity/translateY only), never pointer-driven.
customize.loop_note: End frame (view2 static hold, 8.6-9.0s) is a calm, fully-settled state — an editor can loop the mp4 back toward 0.0s with only the 3D pop-in reappearing as a deliberate 'restart' beat, not a jump-cut.

content.note: Three static PNGs explicitly provided by the user (already redacted to generic placeholder data, no blur), not a live `hyperframes capture`. Treated per the webpage module's 'provided screenshot explicitly selected by the user' allowance. dashboard-1 and dashboard-2 are two consecutive scroll captures of the SAME page (Analíticas) and are stitched into one continuous scrollable stack — see customize.content_viewport.view1_scroll_stack for the exact splice. proceso-legal-1 is a separate page (Procesos legales), reached via a tab switch. Unlike the previous version, the sidebar is NOT cropped out — it stays visible for the entire video and its active-item highlight animates between the two pages.

screens.view: 1 (Analíticas) — bottom of stitched scroll stack, spliced directly after dashboard-1 at y=1636
2 (Procesos legales) — reached via tab switch at 5.6-6.0s

highlights.label: Analíticas content — scroll stack top (headline stats, Valor económico, start of charts)
Analíticas content — scroll stack bottom (chart tails, 6 process stat tiles, Volumen mensual, Distribución por estado)

shot_brief: A calm, confident 9-second loop for the right column of the Aurali hero, rebuilt from client feedback to show the REAL app, sidebar included. The whole app window pops into frame with a subtle diagonal 3D tilt that settles flat, then — with 'Analíticas' highlighted in the always-visible sidebar — the camera glides down the real Analíticas page in one continuous auto-scroll (dashboard-1 into dashboard-2, spliced at the exact point where the second scroll capture continues the first). After ~4.3s of scrolling it settles, then the app switches on its own to 'Procesos legales': the sidebar's highlight pill slides from one item to the other in sync with a content crossfade, and four process cards (Camila Rojas, Andrés Gómez, Valentina Cruz, Santiago Londoño — all generic placeholder data, no blur) cascade into view with a brief glow pulse on their 'Finalizado' pills. No cursor, no click, no narration — the firm's own dashboard, navigating itself. 'Tu despacho, en piloto automático.'
